decisions.reason: An illuminated candle arch fits the firm's core Erzgebirge Christmas range and was featured on the home page. Seasonal decor demand held up during the pandemic, so results likely met aspirations and give no cause for problemistic search.
Christmas pyramids are the firm's established core business with long product life cycles. A home-page product of this kind is likely to meet aspirations and stay in the range.
A Dresden-themed pyramid serves the steady tourist and collector market. It fits the firm's core competence and its prominent placement suggests satisfactory results.

The electronic music box is a newer platform outside the traditional range, so its results are less certain. Its home-page presence and expansion with new discs suggest management still sees enough promise to carry it with available slack.

A second edition of this motif platform appeared in 2019, which indicates demand met expectations. However, licensed themed variants are more exposed to shortfalls and to rationalisation of the range.
A Christmas-themed music box variant matches the firm's seasonal strengths and has little ongoing cost. It is likely to be kept unless the music box line as a whole falls below aspirations.
